Based on the passages from the books, Mikael Blomkvist has several nicknames:

1. **Kalle Blomkvist** (or **Kalle Fucking Blomkvist**) - This is his most prominent nickname, given to him by reporters after he helped expose the Bear Gang bank robberies as a young journalist. He detested it because it was used tauntingly and reminded him of his youth [E1]. Salander also uses this derogatory form [E2].

2. **Micke** - A shorter, more familiar nickname used by Berger [E3].

3. **Master Detective Blomkvist** - Used sarcastically by Salander [E4].

4. **Practical Pig** - A comparison to the character from "The Three Little Pigs" that Salander thinks of when considering whether he would help her [E2].

The most well-known and frequently referenced nickname is **Kalle Blomkvist**, which originated from his early journalistic career when he helped catch the Bear Gang. Despite never having used the name Carl in his life, this became his taunting moniker among peers and reporters [E1].
